name: Will my insurance cover the cost of water removal services?

mainEntity.name: Will my insurance cover the cost of water removal services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many homeowners' and business insurance policies cover water damage restoration, including water removal, if the damage is sudden and accidental. Coverage often depends on the cause of the water damage; for instance, damage from a burst pipe is typically covered, while flood damage may require a separate flood insurance policy. We can assist you with documentation and communication with your insurance provider.
acceptedAnswer.description: Insurance often covers water removal for sudden and accidental damage, but it depends on your specific policy and the cause of damage.
